versions.open: Buy the list at the open, sell at the close
versions.up: Uptrend on the chart (EMA10 > EMA20, price > EMA50)
versions.full: Full uptrend on the chart (also over the 150 line)
versions.full_spy: Full uptrend, and SPY's chart is in the full uptrend too
versions.pull: Full uptrend + SPY up, buy a pullback to the 20 EMA
versions.quick: Full uptrend + SPY up, sell when EMA10 crosses under EMA20
versions.any_mkt: Full uptrend + SPY up, any liquid stock (market check, no sector check)
versions.any: Full uptrend + SPY up, any liquid stock (no daily checks)
